Name: RSNA Abdominal Traumatic Injury CT (RATIC) dataset
Comments: Large, publicly available, expert-labeled dataset of abdominal CT images for traumatic injuries.  Focuses on injuries to the liver, spleen, kidneys, bowel, mesentery, and active extravasation. Used for the RSNA 2023 Abdominal Trauma Detection competition to develop AI models for detecting traumatic injuries in abdominal CT scans.  Aimed at improving the speed and accuracy of trauma diagnosis, particularly valuable in areas with limited subspecialist availability.

Imaging.Acquisition: Variation in protocols across different hospitals (single portal venous phase, multiphasic imaging, split bolus approaches). Specific parameters are not detailed.
